questions.text: From the passage, it can be assumed that the possible drawback of the tote bags trend is which of the following?
options: It ruins the relationship between people and their strong religious beliefs.
It might lead to a problematic culture of performative activism trends.
It encourages people to gain a new sense of political and social awareness.
It persuades consumers to purchase a product solely for vanity purposes.
It makes performative activism exclusive to those who can afford the trend.
questions.correctAnswer: It might lead to a problematic culture of performative activism trends.
questions.explanation: The text states that a tote's simplicity has a 'lack of nuance, in that it becomes easy to talk the talk without walking the walk,' which refers to performative activism.

questions.text: Which statement best summarizes the central idea of the second paragraph?
options: The function of tote bags has shifted from a way to carry things to a way to express one's personal style and taste.
People found themselves drawn to tote bags for their practicality and for how they made others see one's identity.
Ownership of tote bags becomes an act of self-promotion, advertising a subtle statement of one's fashion taste.
Tote bags are a form of personalized statement and expression as they help define a characteristic of the wearer.
A tote bag with a slogan will bring liberation to people whose identities are inherently political
questions.correctAnswer: Tote bags are a form of personalized statement and expression as they help define a characteristic of the wearer.
questions.explanation: The second paragraph emphasizes that a tote bag acts as a blank canvas reflecting personal beliefs, politics, and identity.

questions.text: The sentence "They give each of us the power to say who we are, and to do so in a practical, affordable way." would be best inserted to the passage in which of the following locations?
options: Before Sentence [1]
Before Sentence [2]
After Sentence [3]
After Sentence [4]
After Sentence [5]
questions.explanation: The sentence discusses the practical and affordable way of expressing identity, which naturally leads into Sentence [2] describing the tote bag as a blank canvas for self-expression.
